notes: Shopify storefront (rowenandwren.co.uk), direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no blocking. Enumerated all 161 collections via /collections.json plus the collections sitemap (160 entries, cross-checked) and the full header mega-menu (109+ links, same set used in the prior Home-Decor pass). No collection titled Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Trending/Customer Favourites exists anywhere in the taxonomy. Two orphan collections use favourites-type language and are NOT linked from the current header nav or homepage (found only via collections.json/sitemap enumeration, per Sec.4): 'Favourite Finds' (/collections/favourite-finds, 6 products) and 'Your Favourites' (/collections/your-favourites, 32 products). Opened both. Favourite Finds carries only generic site-wide brand copy in its og:description ('A thoughtful collection of furniture, lighting and homeware, beautifully made...') identical in tone to dozens of other themed 'Edit'/'Collection' pages on this site (The Cosy Edit, Gather & Dine, Stocking Fillers, etc.) -- no popularity/bestseller signal, so excluded as a generic curated marketing collection, not Bestsellers. Your Favourites carries an explicit popularity signal in its own og:description: 'here we gather a collection of our most popular designs, each one a testament to enduring style and craftsmanship' -- this directly matches the brief's 'Most Popular' / 'Customer Favorites' target terms. Confirmed it is a genuine, live, populated PLP (32 products, rendered count span matches products.json exactly, real product grid with filtering/sorting like any other collection page), not a personalized/empty wishlist feature. Recorded as the site's Bestsellers-equivalent listing. It is not currently promoted in the header nav (possibly a legacy or email-campaign page still live on the storefront); noting this for reviewer awareness even though I judged it valid given the strong on-page evidence. No sub-structure (no Furniture/Lighting Bestsellers children) exists for this listing.
